name: hero
prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: finished in-page hero product photograph for the premium speaker brand AURA Audio.
Input images: Image 1 is a website art-direction and hero-product reference only; Image 2 is a material and product-line reference only. Create an original product photograph, not a webpage or screenshot.
Primary request: a wide landscape 3:2 dramatic product photograph of one giant AURA Mini speaker. Mini is a matte-black upright cylindrical speaker with a wide, deeply recessed circular top and an elegant broad silver rim. The ring is the striking central subject. Photograph it from above at a three-quarter angle, similar to the central hero subject of Image 1, with the speaker centered and occupying around 70 percent of the width. The lower speaker body may be cropped and fades seamlessly into pure black. Keep the complete top rim visible.
Scene/backdrop: PURE BLACK seamless studio background. Dramatic, controlled rim lighting emphasizes the silver elliptical rim and very subtle curved matte-black body without lifting the black background. The lower third is especially dark so white website copy can be overlaid there later.
Style/medium: premium minimal photorealistic commercial product photography, realistic finely textured dark speaker material, beautiful physically plausible metal highlights, black/white monochrome.
Text (verbatim): only a tiny subtle physical product brand mark "AURA", spelled A-U-R-A, if visible. No Ronin brand marks.
Constraints: Exactly one speaker. No webpage, no typography, no floating labels, no graphic overlays, no UI, no watermarks, no extra objects.

name: collection
prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: finished product collection photography for AURA Audio.
Input images: Image 1 is a website art-direction and cylinder-shape reference only; Image 2 is a material and speaker-style reference only. Create original AURA products, not a webpage or screenshot.
Primary request: an EXACT 3:1 wide landscape composition on uniform #f4f4f4 light grey seamless studio background, containing exactly three completely separate evenly spaced speaker products. This image will be cropped into three equal-width product cards. Treat the canvas as three invisible equal width thirds: each product is centered within its own third, entirely inside that third with generous margins, no overlaps and no product or significant shadow crosses a third boundary.
LEFT THIRD: AURA Mini, matte-black upright cylinder, slightly taller than wide, with a wide deeply recessed circular top and a broad elegant silver rim matching the website hero reference shape. 
MIDDLE THIRD: AURA One, compact BLACK rounded-square speaker with fine black fabric grille, subtly curved matte-black frame, top controls, small dark metal AURA badge; original simplified proportions inspired by black speaker material in Image 2, no blue light.
RIGHT THIRD: AURA Studio, wider WARM IVORY fabric-wrapped rectangular speaker with rounded corners, four small brass top controls, slim brass foot, very small centered AURA badge; original compact product inspired by ivory material in Image 2.
Composition/framing: each full silhouette visible, each a tasteful three-quarter angle on the ground plane, all products vertically centered with generous space above and below. Comparable visual weight for each of the three products. Camera, scale, lighting, background tone, and ground level consistent across the panorama.
Style/medium: crisp photorealistic professional e-commerce photography, clear fabric and grille detail, soft subtle contact shadows.
Text (verbatim): only small physical product marks "AURA", spelled A-U-R-A. No Ronin brand.
Constraints: The three products must remain completely separate and within their own thirds. No card UI, no panels, no dividers, no lines, no captions, no labels, no extra text, no graphic overlays, no watermarks. EXACT 3:1 aspect ratio.

name: lifestyle
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: finished square editorial product lifestyle photograph for AURA Audio.
Input images: Image 1 is high-end website photography art direction only; Image 2 is material and product styling reference only. Create original AURA products, not a webpage or screenshot.
Primary request: a SQUARE editorial still life with exactly two AURA speakers on a white architectural window ledge in soft diagonal morning sunlight. A subtle sheer white curtain and restrained light grey wall form the background. Refined, quiet high-end magazine commercial product photography with realistic shadows.
Subject positions: AURA One is the BLACK rounded-square speaker positioned taller at rear right. It has a fine black fabric grille, subtly curved matte-black frame, top controls, and a small dark metal AURA badge; original simplified compact shape inspired by the black speaker material in Image 2; no blue light.
AURA Studio is the WARM IVORY fabric-wrapped wider rectangular speaker positioned lower at front left. It has softly rounded corners, four small brass top controls, a slim brass foot, and a tiny centered AURA badge. Original compact product inspired by the ivory material in Image 2.
Composition/framing: both full products clearly visible in an uncluttered, balanced composition; tasteful three-quarter viewpoints and believable scale, enough negative space around both products. Keep the top controls and fabric textures natural and finely detailed.
Color palette: white architecture, restrained grey, black and warm ivory speakers, subtle brass detail. Soft natural tonal contrast, refined realistic light.
Text (verbatim): only tiny physical product marks "AURA", spelled A-U-R-A. No Ronin marks.
Constraints: no people, no labels or external text, no website, no UI, no graphic overlays, no extra products, no watermarks.
